entries.label: Version 1
entries.prompt:
FEATURE BRANCH — First-time help walkthrough prototype for GitHub #52. Do NOT rewrite dashboard/transactions/statements/categories/serviceability/login layout or shared sidebar chrome beyond minimal data-od / data-tour hooks and a tiny Settings stub link.

## Ticket intent (#52)
New users land with no guidance. Build a first-run tutorial: spotlight/tooltip overlays on REAL UI (not a standalone modal-only tour). Progress step N of M. Skip / dismiss anytime. Esc dismisses. localStorage flag `funds.walkthrough.done` (and Settings "Show tutorial again"). Degrades on narrow viewports.

## Guided steps (exact order)
1. Welcome — one sentence what FUNDS does (self-hosted AU personal finance)
2. Statements — upload bank/credit PDF export (highlight dropzone / upload)
3. Transactions — search, filters, category picker, suggestions/bulk affordances
4. Categories — hierarchy, colours, merge/reorder
5. Dashboard — period filter, KPIs, charts / drill-down hint
6. Breakdown / Recurring — shorter optional stop or "learn more" (can be a compact step on Breakdown stub or dual callouts)

## Visual system
Match THIS project's warm paper / modern-minimal tokens (`css/shared.css`) — IBM Plex, hairline, single blue accent. Not purple glass. (Production ticket mentions dark theme; prototype follows redesign system.)

## Deliverables (NEW files preferred)
1. `css/walkthrough.css` — overlay, spotlight cutout, tooltip card, progress, focus trap styling
2. `js/walkthrough.js` — data-driven steps array (selectors + title + body + page href), localStorage, keyboard (Esc), Skip / Next / Back / Got it, auto-start if flag unset when `?tour=1` OR first visit on index/dashboard
3. Wire minimal `data-tour="..."` attributes onto EXISTING pages only where needed: funds-statements, funds-transactions, funds-categories, funds-dashboard (and a light Breakdown stub page OR step that uses a placeholder panel if Breakdown HTML doesn't exist — create `funds-breakdown.html` minimal stub matching chrome if required for step 6)
4. `funds-walkthrough-demo.html` OR enhance `index.html` with a "First-time walkthrough" launcher that resets the flag and starts the tour
5. Tiny Settings affordance: on index or a one-line note + button "Show tutorial again" that clears the flag

## Behaviour
- Tour navigates between pages as steps advance (or uses in-page multi-scene if cleaner — prefer real page navigation with query `?tour=1&step=N` so each core section is visited)
- Always visible: progress, Skip tutorial, Next
- Don't block forever; overlay allows Esc / Skip
- Copy should be concise, action-oriented

## Out of scope
- Real auth, video, every-page contextual help, server-persisted state
- Rewriting the main redesign screens

When done, list files touched and confirm main screen layouts were not redesigned.
